rationale: This index is driven by global M2 money supply (50% weight, 90-day lagged) as the primary signal, with on-chain metrics as secondary confirmation. The core thesis is that Bitcoin is a global liquidity barometer: when central banks expand money supply (QE, rate cuts), risk assets and BTC rally; when they contract (QT, rate hikes), BTC falls. The M2 map is calibrated so that contractionary regimes (global_m2 below 71, corresponding to the 2018-2019 bear and 2022 crash environments) produce scores below 25 (buy territory), while peak-expansion readings (global_m2 above 90, as seen near the 2021 ATH) produce scores above 78 (sell territory). The 90-day lag is already baked into the dataset — it means the signal reflects what M2 was doing three months ago, giving confirmation that a trend has been established rather than reacting to noise. NUPL (18%) and MVRV (14%) serve as cycle-position validators: they must corroborate the macro signal before confidence is high. Mayer multiple (10%) flags extreme price dislocations from the 200DMA that sometimes lead macro signals at tops and bottoms. Puell (8%) catches miner-distress bottoms that occasionally precede macro recovery. Buy threshold of 28 targets confirmed bear markets with M2 contraction — typically mid-to-late bear phases where the macro environment has been restrictive long enough to compress price to value. Sell threshold of 70 fires as M2 peaks and on-chain metrics confirm distribution — well before the absolute top but capturing the bulk of the bull run. min_days_in_zone of 30 enforces macro patience: a genuine M2 contraction cycle plays out over months, so 30 consecutive days in buy territory confirms a real regime rather than a transient dip. DCA over 5 tranches every 21 days (a total ~84-day accumulation window) mirrors the slow deployment of capital characteristic of macro investors who build positions over a quarter. Gradual exit (25% per signal) prevents premature full liquidation when M2 is near but not at peak — macro tops are multi-month affairs and multiple partial sells at 70+ capture more upside than a single lump-sum exit.
